subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the umbrella until the Anthropic signed-thinking replay-prevention PR lands, or hand off the remaining work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 now that the recovery carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: The remaining fix changes provider replay policy for signed thinking blocks, and current evidence supports multiple plausible closure/routing shapes that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Move the remaining prevention work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 and close this issue only after a clear handoff comment preserves the evidence links.

options.title: Defer Prevention After Recovery
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as enough for now and leave prevention to a later provider replay policy review, accepting that the issue remains a product decision rather than a completed bug fix.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: He already commented on the landed recovery half and the remaining open path, and is the best available routing candidate from the observed discussion and history.
